description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Plot_Radar class, which is a subclass of Image_Graph_Plot, responsible for rendering radar chart plots within the Image_Graph PHP library. It includes methods for drawing the legend sample and outputting the plot, including handling dataset points and styles.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_Radar
classes.description: A class for rendering radar chart plots as part of the Image_Graph PHP graphing library. It handles drawing radar-specific plot elements and rendering the complete plot area.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample representation of the radar plot for the legend, illustrating how the plot appears with randomly positioned vertices within a defined area.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Finalizes the rendering of the radar plot by drawing dataset polygons, handling the plot area and styles, and managing canvas operations.
